nodes.description: Owner-only function that enables trading and the automatic swap/liquidate flag.
Core transfer override handling blacklists, max-tx limits, fee taking, dividend tracker balance sync and dividend processing.
Private function swapping contract tokens for ETH and forwarding all received ETH to a hardcoded dev/marketing address.
Private function approving the router and swapping tokens for the dividend token along a hardcoded path.
Private function that swaps tokens for the dividend token and forwards it to the dividend tracker for distribution.
Private function approving the router and swapping tokens for ETH.
Public function that calls dividendTracker.process(gas) and emits an event containing tx.origin.
Public function letting msg.sender claim accumulated dividends via the tracker.
Owner-only function syncing a holder balance into the tracker and triggering a claim.
Gas-bounded loop iterating token holders with gasleft() and auto-claiming dividends.
Owner-only function withdrawing dividends for an account and writing lastClaimTimes with block.timestamp.
Owner-only function removing an account from the dividend holder map.
Disabled withdrawDividend override that always reverts.
Internal-token based dividend distribution using magnifiedDividendPerShare and SafeMath.
Payable dividend distribution using msg.value and magnifiedDividendPerShare.
Public function withdrawing dividends for msg.sender.
Unprotected public setter that changes the dividend token address used for withdrawals.
Internal function updating withdrawnDividends then performing an external ERC20 transfer of the dividend token.
Internal function minting or burning tracker tokens to reach a target balance.
Owner-only ownership transfer.
Owner-only function that sets the owner to address(0).
Function that lets only the liquidityWallet address toggle the dev-fee/swap flag.
Owner-only function adding an account to the blacklist.
Deploys the dividend tracker, creates the Uniswap pair, configures exclusions and mints the total supply.
Flag controlling whether automatic liquidations/swaps may run inside _transfer.
Address that can toggle the dev fee and is exempt from swaps.
Reference to the aETHERDividendTracker contract, target of many external calls.
Hardcoded dividend token (WETH) used for reward swaps.
Flag gating all transfers, fees and swaps.
Gas budget used when calling dividendTracker.process.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers a liquidation.
Mapping of addresses treated as AMM pairs (max-sell and swap triggers).
Mapping of accounts exempt from transfer fees.
Mapping of blacklisted addresses blocked in _transfer.
Uniswap V2 router used for all swaps.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address for this token.
Storage slot holding the privileged owner address.
ERC20 balance mapping mutated by _transfer/_mint/_burn.
Magnified dividend accumulator updated on every distribution.
Mapping of dividends already withdrawn per user.
Signed correction mapping keeping dividends constant across balance changes.
Cumulative amount of dividend assets distributed.
Mapping of last claim timestamps used for auto-claim eligibility.
Minimum wait time between claims, compared against block.timestamp.
Mapping of accounts excluded from dividend accounting.
Address of the ERC20 paid out as dividends; mutable by anyone via setDividendTokenAddress.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, blacklist checks and dividend withdrawal.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for claim waits and swap deadlines.
Origin-controlled address only used in emit statements.
External ERC20 transfer of dividends inside _withdrawDividendOfUser before state is finalized.
External ERC20 transfer of the dividend token to the dividend tracker in swapAndSendDividends.
External Uniswap router call with block.timestamp deadline and 0 slippage tolerance.
External Uniswap router call with block.timestamp deadline and 0 slippage tolerance.
Raw ETH transfer to a hardcoded dev address executed while liquidating is true.
Fee arithmetic amount.mul(TOTAL_FEES).div(100) and supply-based division in _transfer.
magnifiedDividendPerShare.add(value.mul(magnitude)/totalSupply()) accumulation math.
External call to dividendTracker.process(gas) embedded inside _transfer (callback into tracker).
External call to dividendTracker.setBalance wrapped in try/catch inside _transfer.
Source address parameter of aETHER._transfer.
Destination address parameter of aETHER._transfer.
Transfer amount parameter of aETHER._transfer.
Account parameter of aETHERDividendTracker.setBalance.
New balance parameter of aETHERDividendTracker.setBalance.
User parameter of DividendPayingToken._withdrawDividendOfUser.
Local computed withdrawable dividend amount.
Gas budget parameter passed to dividendTracker.process.
Token amount parameter of swapAndSendToDev / swapAndSendDividends / swapTokensForEth.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside _transfer to enforce blacklist and exemption checks on the caller.
enableDisableDevFee requires msg.sender == liquidityWallet, a wallet-based authorization check.
msg.sender is passed as the user whose dividends are withdrawn.
processAccount writes lastClaimTimes with block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency for claims.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForDividendToken.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
tx.origin is embedded in the ProcessedDividendTracker event emitted by processDividendTracker.
tx.origin is embedded in the ProcessedDividendTracker event emitted from within _transfer.
_transfer triggers swapAndSendToDev during liquidation while the liquidating flag is set.
_transfer triggers swapAndSendDividends during liquidation inside the same unevaluated state window.
Transfer amount flows into the fee computation amount.mul(TOTAL_FEES).div(100).
_transfer performs an external callback into dividendTracker.process(gas) after transfers.
_transfer performs an external callback into dividendTracker.setBalance inside try/catch.
swapAndSendToDev calls swapTokensForEth to obtain ETH before forwarding it.
swapAndSendToDev forwards the swapped ETH with a raw transfer to the dev address.
swapAndSendDividends calls swapTokensForDividendToken to convert tokens.
swapAndSendDividends performs an external ERC20 transfer of the dividend token to the tracker.
swapTokensForDividendToken calls the Uniswap router external swap function.
swapTokensForEth calls the Uniswap router external swap function.
_withdrawDividendOfUser calls the external ERC20 dividend token transfer.
processDividendTracker externally invokes dividendTracker.process(gas).
claim externally calls dividendTracker.processAccount for msg.sender.
setBalance invokes processAccount after syncing the holder balance.
setBalance reads excludedFromDividends before deciding whether to sync the holder.
process loops holders and calls processAccount for each eligible account.
process reads lastClaimTimes inside canAutoClaim to decide eligibility.
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser which performs an external token transfer.
processAccount stores block.timestamp into lastClaimTimes of the account.
excludeFromDividends writes excludedFromDividends for the account.
distributeDividends(uint256) updates magnifiedDividendPerShare using magnitude math.
payable distributeDividends updates magnifiedDividendPerShare from msg.value using magnitude math.
setDividendTokenAddress lets any caller overwrite the dividendToken payout address without authorization.
withdrawDividend routes to _withdrawDividendOfUser which transfers the dividend token.
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner storage slot.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the _owner storage slot.
enableDisableDevFee lets the liquidityWallet address flip the _swapEnabled flag.
addBotToBlackList writes _isBlackListedBot for an owner-chosen account.
activate sets _swapEnabled to true.
activate sets tradingEnabled to true, gating transfers.
constructor stores the created Uniswap pair into the immutable uniswapV2Pair.
constructor deploys and assigns the dividendTracker contract reference.
_transfer compares from/to against liquidityWallet to skip liquidation.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to decide max-sell and liquidation branches.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to skip fee taking.
_transfer reads gasForProcessing to size the dividend tracker call.
_transfer reads and mutates ERC20 balances through super._transfer.
swapAndSendToDev consumes the tokens parameter as the swap input.
swapAndSendToDev captures initialBalance to compute the newly received ETH.
_withdrawDividendOfUser stores the computed amount in _withdrawableDividend.
_withdrawDividendOfUser updates withdrawnDividends before/after the external transfer.
_withdrawDividendOfUser uses the user parameter for the payout.
_withdrawDividendOfUser transfers the mutable dividendToken address.
The tracker call from _transfer resolves into aETHERDividendTracker.setBalance.
The tracker process call resolves into aETHERDividendTracker.process.
The gas parameter bounds the processing loop iteration budget.
distributeDividends increments totalDividendsDistributed by the distributed amount.
payable distributeDividends increments totalDividendsDistributed by msg.value.

normalization_plan.reason: The from address parameter only exists within _transfer and should be normalized into that core function node.
The to address parameter is a local artifact of _transfer and has no independent identity.
The amount parameter feeds fee and limit logic internal to _transfer.
The account parameter is scoped to setBalance and should collapse into that function node.
The newBalance parameter only drives the tracker sync performed by setBalance.
The user parameter is internal to _withdrawDividendOfUser and has no external identity.
The local computed amount is transient state owned by the withdrawal function.
The gas budget parameter is consumed by the tracker process call initiated from the main contract.
The tokens parameter is the swap input local to the liquidation helpers.
The captured initial ETH balance is a transient local of swapAndSendToDev.
